title: Federated Binary Gating with Server-Side Vision-Language Inference for Surveillance Anomaly Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.07403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy-sensitive surveillance systems could benefit from large vision-language models (VLMs), but such models typically require centralized access to raw video. In federated learning settings, this challenge is amplified by non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) client data, which can make direct multiclass anomaly classification unstable, especially for rare categories. We propose a hybrid two-stage architecture that combines a federated binary convolutional neural network (CNN) gate with server-side zero-shot VLM inference. The lightweight LiteCNN3D gate performs local anomaly screening and forwards only flagged videos to Qwen3-VL-8B, which assigns them to four anomaly metaclasses. We evaluate this design on UCF-Crime grouped into five coarse metaclasses and implement the federated stage in a real three-node heterogeneous deployment. translated_title: 基于联邦二值门控与服务器端视觉-语言推理的监控异常分类
translated_abstract: 隐私敏感的监控系统可以从大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）中受益，但此类模型通常需要对原始视频进行集中式访问。在联邦学习环境中，非独立同分布的客户端数据加剧了这一挑战，可能使直接的多类别异常分类变得不稳定，尤其是对于稀有类别。我们提出了一种混合两阶段架构，将联邦二值卷积神经网络（CNN）门控与服务器端零样本视觉-语言推理相结合。轻量级的LiteCNN3D门控执行本地异常筛查，仅将被标记的视频转发给Qwen3-VL-8B，由其将视频分配到四个异常元类别中。我们在划分为五个粗粒度元类别的UCF-Crime数据集上评估了该设计，并在真实的三节点异构部署中实现了联邦阶段。在所研究的设置中，直接的联邦多类别训练会崩溃，而……（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种混合两阶段架构，利用轻量级联邦二值CNN门控在本地进行异常筛查，仅将可疑视频传输至服务器端由零样本视觉-语言模型（Qwen3-VL-8B）进行元类别分类，从而在隐私敏感且数据非独立同分布的监控场景中避免了直接联邦多类训练的崩溃问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid two-stage architecture that uses a lightweight federated binary CNN gate for local anomaly screening, forwarding only flagged videos to server-side zero-shot vision-language inference (Qwen3-VL-8B) for metaclass classification, thereby avoiding the collapse of direct federated multiclass training in privacy-sensitive, non-IID surveillance settings.
